research_notes: Follow up full-time status and breaks across all paid work; identify café and Melbourne broadcast employers, 2HD start and 2NURFM dates/pay status; establish 1993–1997 HROC/Hunter Tourism legal employer control.

2026-09-29 searches covered APH biography and handbooks, personal biography/first-speech index, Radio Today/RadioInfo 2013 departure, employer 2NURFM election report, ABC election guides, HROC historical timeline, university governance and public professional-profile leads. Targeted full-time searches yielded unrelated jobs/policies, not her work hours.

Do not carry present Hunter JO structure back to 1993. 2024 primary timeline locates later incorporation in 2002 and commercial company in 2003–04. Historical constitution/annual reports remain a better avenue for period control. Hunter Tourism could be industry/nonprofit or council-associated; funding alone does not decide.

Café Delish is an unverified lead from reporting about her spouse, not a verified employer or dates for her. RadioInfo says employment scheduled to expire 20 December 2013 while Radio Today describes earlier on-air departure on 13 December; retain month until contractual end clarified. On-air hours are not total working hours. Last follow-up 2026-09-29; all aggregate/subspell overlaps are non-additive.

2026-10-01 follow-up: added primary-register company governance dates and primary dated observations of2HD in2012 and2NURFM4September2015. Read full first speech, government press conference, industry awards list, APH register index and radio-trade archive. Neither on-air schedule nor awards establish full-time hours. No quantified full-time interval.

Cafe Delish remains a lead: ChannelNews repeats spouse’s professional-profile description of their joint proposal but spouse’s2002–2005 ownership dates cannot replace her APH2001–2004 work dates. NEW FM breakfast2009 lead appears on a public discussion forum only; seek station/industry archive before adding. Full-time/part-time and maiden-name searches yielded no personal contract evidence. Historical HROC/Tourism control, Melbourne station and individual broadcasting starts remain unresolved. Register PDF restricted, first-speech APH403; accessible indexed/transcript evidence used without bypass. No duplicate duration across umbrella broadcasting and individual roles.

Second follow-up2October2026: full2018 parliamentary broadcasting speech establishes 2NURFM volunteer-to-paid transition; date and contractual hours still unknown.2013 first-person industry interview gives five-day/four-hour live show but not total labour hours. Targeted NEW FM2009, Melbourne, cafe and Hunter Tourism searches did not independently resolve employer boundaries or period control. RadioToday20-year multi-city career description belongs to Jay Walkerden, not Swanson. Jocks Journal January2024 PDF contains a ten-years-ago column about2013 departure; not a new appointment. Retain personnel/annual-report and pre-incorporation HROC constitution avenues; do not repeat generic biography searches.

Third follow-up3October2026: exact-name cafe searches found only May2021 ChannelNews reporting of spouse Nick's public profile, including his August2002-November2005 Cafe Delish ownership; those are his dates and cannot be assigned to Meryl. A public2009 radio forum and a current secondary station-history page suggest NEWFM/2HD programme slots, but neither provides a station employment archive, contract, total hours or reliable personal boundary, so no spell dates were changed. Hunter Tourism/HROC control, Melbourne employer, 2NURFM volunteer-to-paid transition and all substantive-hours gaps remain unresolved. Advance the national cursor and do not repeat generic biography, cafe or NEWFM searches without a new primary lead.

Fourth follow-up4October2026: targeted Hunter Tourism, HROC, 2NURFM and NEWFM searches again returned the official chronology, current biographies, the already recorded employer article and a2009 listener-forum programme listing. No historical organisation record, station personnel archive, legal employer, volunteer-to-paid transition date, contract or total working hours emerged. A current station-history page lists a2011 programme slot but is not a personnel record or work-hours statement. Generic exact-name broadcasting and regional-organisation searches are exhausted pending primary archival material.

Follow-up2026-10-04: New June2026 Hansard statement says NBN gave her first media job in1990; explicit conflict retained without overriding APH1991 start or inventing an earlier casual spell. ProCare/HPCA organisation page currently lists her as patron, but no appointment or pre10September2026 observation was found; retain as a governance follow-up lead rather than backdate current listing into frozen career. Other patrons’ broadcasting positions and staff’s explicit full-time terms are not Swanson’s evidence. Regional executive/station terms remain unknown.
